comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (45.5%) to fish histone H1 A: 15%, S: 14%, K: 23%, R: 12%. GRAVY: -1.15, mol wt: 20733.553, mol formula: C903H1600N310O241S2, mol ex coeff: 4470. Activity: Active against Gram+ B. cereus (MIC 3.8 ug/ml), E-faecalis (MIC >32 ug/ml), L. monocytogenes (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. aureus or MRSA (MIC 2.4-3.8 ug/ml), anti-VRE (MIC 4 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli (MIC 4.9 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa (MIC 2.9 ug/ml), and S. typhimurium (MIC 1.9 ug/ml).
